judgement.reason: PostHog's core analytics ingestion and storage need ClickHouse and Kafka, which Deployz does not provide, and its Node.js ingestion services are built as a separate image.

evidence.quote: # Node.js services are built separately using Dockerfile.node.
[PostHog](https://posthog.com/) ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.
